How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
Message from Smile Concierge:
For the best results with the Invisalign™ Ultrasonic Cleaner: 
Fill the tank with water to the maximum level indicated. Optionally add 5g of Invisalign™ Cleaning Crystals+.
Place up to two aligners or retainers in the tank, inside-up. Do not stack them, and make sure no air bubbles are trapped.
Put the lid on and connect the power cable.
Tap the power button to start the 5-minute cleaning cycle. The cleaner stops automatically when complete.
Unplug the cleaner, discard the used water, and rinse both the aligners and the cleaner thoroughly.
Please do not use the Ultrasonic Cleaner if you have a pacemaker.
